Ownable private owner address governing all onlyOwner functions
msg.sender - attacker controlled caller used for payments, ownership checks and minting
block.timestamp - miner influenceable timestamp used as enrolment start date
buyLand(Coordinate[]): payable entry point that prices, occupies and mints land and pulls ERC20 payment
changeRealEstate: owner pays to change the type of their real estate pieces
externalChangeRealEstate: only allowed modifiers may change types and charge an arbitrary owner
validateTokensToBeChanged: internal ownership and type-difference validation
calculateLandPrice: view pricing of a list of coordinates from layer range pricing
calculateRealEstatePrice: view pricing of a list of tokens by their layer and new type
validateCoordinates: bounds and occupancy checks for coordinates
enrollInOffice: enrol worker NFTs into an owned office and notify the booster watcher with block.timestamp
retrieveHuman: remove workers from an office and notify the booster watcher with 0
notifyYielder: internal external call into tokenAddress interpreted as IBoostWatcher.watchBooster
lockCoordinates: owner-only marking of coordinates as occupied
unlockCoordinates: owner-only clearing of coordinate occupancy
reserveCoordinates: owner-only mint and occupancy of coordinates without payment
occupyLand: internal minting of land tokens, storing type, coordinates and occupancy
withdrawTokens: owner-only transfer of the whole ERC20 balance to msg.sender
setLayerConfiguration: owner-only bulk configuration of a layer, its types and pricing
setLayerLock: owner-only toggling of the layer lock flag
setLayerLength: owner-only extension of a layer length and its additional pricing
setLayerLandPricing: owner-only overwrite of the range pricing of a layer
setLayerTypesPricing: owner-only overwrite of building type pricing
removeLayerTypesPricing: owner-only deletion of type pricing and enrolment slots
setLayerRealEstateTypeEnrolmentConfig: owner-only update of enrolment slot counts
setBaseURI: owner-only update of the metadata base URI
pause: owner-only pausing of the contract
unpause: owner-only unpausing of the contract
setTokenAddress: owner-only change of the external token/booster contract address
addAllowedModifiers: owner-only addition of accounts to the modifier whitelist
removeAllowedModifiers: owner-only removal of accounts from the modifier whitelist
addCollection: owner-only addition of an enrollable NFT collection
removeCollection: owner-only removal of an enrollable NFT collection
setOfficeBoost: owner-only update of bonusPercentage
computeAmount: view boost computation amount + amount*bonusPercentage/100
tokenURI: builds the metadata URI from baseURI and the decimal token id
getTokensEnrolments: view returning the worker lists of the given offices (contains a faulty loop counter)
_getLayerConfiguration: internal loader that reverts on unconfigured layers
_abs: internal absolute value helper for int256 coordinates
ERC721P._safeMint: mint followed by a receiver callback check
ERC721P._checkOnERC721Received: private callback into the receiver contract via onERC721Received
ERC721P._transfer: internal ownership transfer clearing approvals
ERC721P.ownerOf: reads the owner of a token from the _owners array
ERC721P._mint: internal mint that pushes to _owners and runs the transfer hook
ERC721P._beforeTokenTransfer: overridable hook called before every ownership change
External IERC20(tokenAddress).transferFrom call executed inside buyLand/changeRealEstate/externalChangeRealEstate
